authority: PRE_REGISTRATION (declared before outcome-bearing runs; runtime runner must re-verify shapes/dtypes/bytes and FAIL on mismatch)
position_state_note: Mamba2Cache has NO seqlen_offset / no internal position counter. Sequence position is CALLER-managed via the cache_position LongTensor passed to forward(); only cache_position[0] is consumed (==0 => prefill/init path, >0 => single-token decode path). Therefore position is NOT part of the serialized module state; it is a call-site argument that the lifecycle harness must supply on restore.
decode_path_constraint: torch_forward decode branch (cache_position[0]>0) is SINGLE-TOKEN ONLY: dt=dt[:,0,:] and update_conv_state(cache_init=False) consumes new_conv_state[:,0,:], emitting exactly one output token. A multi-token continuation segment is NOT processed in a single decode call by this backend; faithful continuation of a k-token segment requires k sequential single-token decode steps. Prefill (cache_position[0]==0) uses the chunked naive-ssd path over the whole prefix.

sequence_owned_state_components.name: conv_states
sequence_owned_state_components.owner: Mamba2Cache (shared across all 48 layers, indexed by layer_idx dim 0)
sequence_owned_state_components.dtype: model dtype (bf16 as loaded); runner records live
sequence_owned_state_components.mutation_semantics: IN-PLACE slice writes. Prefill: update_conv_state(cache_init=True) pads the prefix's last conv_kernel columns. Decode: update_conv_state(cache_init=False) roll(shift=-1,dim=-1) then write new token at [:,:,-1]. In-place => a snapshot MUST .clone(), a plain reference is contaminated by later steps.
sequence_owned_state_components.serialization_semantics: dense tensor; lossless via raw bytes or torch.save; bf16 round-trip is exact.
sequence_owned_state_components.restore_semantics: reconstruct Mamba2Cache then copy_() bytes into conv_states; shape/dtype/device must match.

sequence_owned_state_components.name: ssm_states
sequence_owned_state_components.owner: Mamba2Cache (shared across all 48 layers, indexed by layer_idx dim 0)
sequence_owned_state_components.dtype: model dtype (bf16 as loaded); runner records live
sequence_owned_state_components.mutation_semantics: IN-PLACE via update_ssm_state (assignment to ssm_states[layer_idx]). Prefill writes the per-chunk final state; decode writes state*dA + dBx. Snapshot MUST .clone().
sequence_owned_state_components.serialization_semantics: dense tensor; lossless; bf16 round-trip exact.
sequence_owned_state_components.restore_semantics: reconstruct Mamba2Cache then copy_() bytes into ssm_states.

derived_or_scalar_metadata_not_mutable_s.note: These are set at cache __init__ from config and never mutated by forward. They are config-derived, not sequence-owned state; recorded for completeness of the round-trip contract.

caller_managed_not_module_state.cache_position: LongTensor supplied per forward() call; only element [0] is read; NOT stored in cache; harness must supply correct offset on restore/continue.
caller_managed_not_module_state.attention_mask: optional; for equal-length unpadded lifecycle inputs it is None; padding semantics are OUT OF SCOPE for 06A (single-length isolation batches only).

full_module_state_completeness_claim: The COMPLETE sequence-owned recurrent state of this backend is exactly {conv_states, ssm_states}. There is no other mutable per-sequence tensor (no attention KV cache, no position counter inside the cache). This is the RNN-05A lesson applied: full-module lifecycle here == both conv AND ssm states for ALL 48 layers, not a matrix-only subset. Runner enumerates and byte-accounts BOTH before minting any PASS.
